notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}.
description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}.
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving the nontoken Peregrine Drake +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.
